description: Office of the Chief Secretary-Uva Province - Statute (amendment) of Uva Prouncial Road
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the amendment of a provincial roads statute, which involves legal/regulatory matters. The content focuses on establishing legal frameworks and regulatory requirements rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
